utility.notes: The City of Colton Electric Utility is the city's own municipal electric utility, established in 1887, a member of the Southern California Public Power Authority (SCPPA). Colton is notably absent from SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet, consistent with Colton having its own municipal utility rather than SCE service.

value.name: City of Colton Electric Utility
value.notes: Colton Electric is a vertically-integrated municipal utility (like Riverside Public Utilities, Banning Electric Utility, Burbank Water and Power, and Glendale Water and Power) — it procures and delivers its own power to approximately 20,429 customers rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA. No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Colton in the sources reviewed this session.

inspection_steps.notes: The page requires a Production Meter and two AC disconnects and notes appointments are required for pre-installation meetings, but does not itself detail the inspection-scheduling process.

other_conditions: System sizing capped at 100% of the customer's actual 12-month energy consumption, with no exceptions
Alternative sizing of 2 watts per square foot used if consumption history is unavailable
Production Meter and two AC disconnects are mandatory
Net metering is a 1:1 kWh credit system with an annual true-up in June; unused credits paid at $0.04/kWh
